entities.name: Dick Van Arsdale
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Richard Albert Van Arsdale was an American professional basketball player in the National Basketball Association (NBA). A three-time NBA All-Star selection, his No. 5 was retired by the Phoenix Suns.
